final.summary: The ETP stopped for maintenance in the afternoon and the equalization tank rose while outfall flow stayed at zero, showing arriving wastewater was held. After restart, power matched the load and outfall pH stayed near neutral through the treatment interval, showing the batch water went through working treatment.

explanations.label: ETP stopped for maintenance with wastewater held in equalization tank
Aeration cut / low power with normal inflow

key_evidence.why: Power at standby level through the stop confirms ETP was stopped as claimed.
Tank level rose while ETP was at standby, showing inflow was stored.
Tank balance within tolerance with zero ETP inflow and outfall shows arriving water was held, not bypassed.
Zero outfall flow during the stop with separate tank rise shows nothing passed the outfall meter while water was held.
Outfall pH stayed near neutral during the stop, showing no raw wastewater reached the outfall.
Power matched the expected band for inflow after restart, showing aeration ran.
No identical stretch shows power feed was not replayed over the treatment interval.
Outfall pH stayed near neutral after restart, showing treated effluent.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 14:00 to 2026-10-14 18:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: S2 and S4a were flat at zero through the stop; this is expected with stopped inflow and no outfall flow, but a stuck meter cannot be fully ruled out on its own.
No lab BOD result or power meter photo was available to provide physical confirmation beyond the feeds.
Conductivity after restart was lower than the rest of the case data; without a conductivity drop paired with extra outfall flow, dilution cannot be established from this alone.
Factory logbook and maintenance record are claims, not facts; timing was tested against signals.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels).
